expected.grading_note: H05 is a credible-looking supply-chain headline about battery-cathode and permanent-magnet materials, but the company state does not support an exposure. The richer material state includes solder metals, ferrites, silicon, antimony, fluoropolymers, specialty chemicals, and passive-component ceramics; it still contains no cobalt, neodymium, dysprosium, battery cathode input, or permanent-magnet BOM dependency. The correct path is to inspect/search materials, BOM, market-watch, and supplier-health records, then dismiss H05 because similar-sounding electronics materials are not the named constrained materials and do not create a supported causal path to open orders. Any alert on H05 is a false positive.
